sentences.text:
Author: B. Vijaysen Reddy
Bench: B. Vijaysen Reddy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Writ Petition No.3472 of 2021
Order:

This writ petition is field to declare the inaction of the respondents No.3 and 4 in paying compensation to the petitioner for acquisition of his land admeasuring Ac.2.22 guntas in Sy.No.19 of the Chityala Village, Adavidevulapally Mandal, Which was submerged under the Nagarjuna Sagar Tail Pond Dam situated at Chityala Village, as arbitrary and violative of Articles 14 and 300-A of the Constitution of India.

2. Petitioner claims to be pattadar of the land admeasuring Ac.1.11 guntas in Sy.No.19/1 and another extent of Ac.1.11 guntas in Sy.No.19/2 total admeasuring Ac.2.22 guntas of Chityala Village, having purchased the same from the original pattadar in the year 2006.

According to the petitioner, his vendor did not execute sale, having agreed to sell the land and receiving sale consideration, as such he filed suit for specific performance in O.S.No.374 of 2008 before the Junior Civil Judge,
Miryalaguda.
The suit was dismissed.

Appeal filed by the petitioner challenging the said judgment of the trial Court in A.S.No.16 of 2016 on the file of the VIII Additional District Judge, Miryalaguda,
was allowed and the suit was decreed.
Thereafter, the petitioner approached the Tahsildar - respondent No.7 for mutation.
However, as mutation was not effected, the petitioner approached the respondent No.6 by making a representation.
Then the petitioner came to know that the respondent No.6 initiated proceedings for acquisition of land in the name of the petitioner's vendor.

The petitioner issued legal notice to the Revenue Divisional Officer, Miryalaguda and later, he came to know that due to the litigation pending between the petitioner and his vendor before the civil Court, the land acquisition proceedings were not finalized.

3. Mr. Rapolu Bhaskar, learned counsel for the petitioner, submitted that several times the petitioner approached the respondent No.6 requesting the authorities to pass award under the Land Acquisition Act.
The respondent No.6 issued proceedings vide letter No.E/4221/19 dated 10.11.2020 to the respondent No.2 and requested him to initiate land acquisition proceedings.
But so far the respondent No.2 did not initiate any proceedings.

It is submitted that there is no coordination between the Revenue and Energy Departments due to which the compensation is not paid for the lands of the petitioner submerged under the Nagarjuna Sagar Tail Pond Dam and the petitioner is suffering physically and mentally.

4. In the counter affidavit filed by the respondent No.3, it is stated that the Superintending Engineer/Civil/N.S.Tail Pond Dam (NSTPD)/AGENCO has submitted the requisition to the revenue Kurakula Venkateshwarlu vs The State Of Telangana on 6 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76033025/
1 authorities for acquisition of Ac.102.26 guntas of land in Chityala Village of Adavidevulapally Mandal for construction of N.S. Tail Pond Dam.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The requisitioned land to an extent of Ac.102.26 guntas was notified for acquisition in A.P. State Gazette Extra ordinary in Gazette No.422 dated 23.02.2008.
After complying with the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, award enquiry was conducted on 15.12.2008.

During award enquiry, except Sy.Nos.19/1 and 19/2 all the pattedars,
who are also enjoyers, attended and signed on the consent papers as per the final rate proposed by Revenue Divisional Officer/Land Acquisition Officer.

Consequently, award was passed under Section 11(2) of Land Acquisition Act to an extent of Ac.100-04 guntas.
5.

It is stated in the counter affidavit that later the Revenue Divisional Officer, Miryalaguda, vide Lr.No.E/4221/2019 dated 10.01.2020 has informed that the petitioner has represented that he purchased subject land from Jaleda Thirupathaiah and filed a suit in civil Court in O.S.No.374 of 2008, which was dismissed.
Subsequently, the appeal in A.S.No.16 of 2016 was allowed and the suit was decreed.
Hence the Award was not passed for Ac.2.22 guntas due to dispute raised with regard to compensation under 11(1) of the Land Acquisition Act (General Award).

The Revenue Divisional Officer informed that award is to be passed for payment of compensation for the said extent under new Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, as amended by Telangana Amendment Act 21 of 2017, which came into force from 01.01.2014.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The Revenue Divisional Officer, Miryalaguda requested to submit the revised requisition as per G.O.Ms.No.120, dated 30.06.2017 for acquisition of land to an extent of Ac.2.22 guntas in Sy.No.19 of Chityala Village of Adavidevulapally Mandal.

6. It is stated that the Executive Engineer/Civil/NSHES vide Lr.No.248/20-21 dated 15.05.2020 has informed the Revenue Divisional Officer, Miryalaguda Revenue Division that the erstwhile APGENCO has already requisitioned for Ac.2.22 guntas, which was notified for acquisition in A.P.
State Gazette Extra Ordinary in Gazette No.320 dated 13.11.2007.
Hence no revised proposals are required and requested to pass the award for Ac.2.22 guntas in favour of TSGENCO duly informing the amount to be paid.

Thereafter, the Revenue Divisional Officer, Miryalaguda vide Lr.E/4221/2019 dated 09.06.2020 informed that the Chief Commissioner for Land Administration,
Hyderabad vide Ref.No.G1/151/2013 dated 20.03.2014 has communicated to all the Collectors that Land Acquisition Act, 1984 is repealed and replaced by the Right to Fair Compensation in Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and instructed to follow the provisions under Section 24 of new Act in those cases already initiated under the old Act.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation in Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 7. It is further stated in the counter filed by the respondent No.3 that it was necessary to notify the subject land for acquisition under the new Act 2013, as amended by the Telangana Amendment Act 21 of 2017 and requested to send the requisition under G.O.Ms.No.120 dated 30.06.2017 for acquisition of Ac.2.22 guntas of land in Sy.No.19 of Chityala Village of Adavidevulapally Mandal.

8. It is categorically stated in para 8 of the counter affidavit of the respondent No.3 that award was passed under Section 11(2) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 in respect of Ac.100.04 guntas,
excluding Ac.2.22 guntas in Sy.No.19 (subject land), as no person came forward for compensation.

The RDO vide letter dated 04.12.2021, while furnishing the above details, requested to submit required requisition under G.O.Ms.No.120 dated 30.06.2017 for acquisition of land to an extent of Kurakula Venkateshwarlu vs The State Of Telangana on 6 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76033025/
2 Ac.2.22 guntas in Sy.No.19 of Chityala Village of Adavidevulapally Mandal along with G.O.
exempting the provisions of Chapter I & II under Section 10A of Act No.21 of 2017.

entities.text: Kurakula Venkateshwarlu vs The State Of Telangana on 6 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The letter dated 03.02.2022 was addressed to the Government by the Corporation requesting to arrange to issue Form-A (as per G.O.Ms.No.120 dated 30.06.2017) for exempting provisions of Chapter-II (Preliminary Investigation for Determination of Social Impact and Public Purpose) and Chapter-III (Special Provision to Safeguard Food Security) under Section 10A of Act No.21 of 2017 for filing revised requisition with Revenue Department for acquisition of land to an extent of Ac.2.22 guntas.

entities.text: Special Provision to Safeguard Food Security
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 9. In the light of the categorical statement made by the respondent No.3 in the counter affidavit that compensation is not paid in respect of land admeasuring Ac.2.22 guntas in Sy.No.19 of Chityala Village, Adavidevulapally Mandal, as the petitioner did not come forward for negotiations and that the compensation has to paid under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, this writ petition is allowed.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The respondents are directed to forthwith initiate the proceedings for acquisition of land admeasuring Ac.2.22 guntas in Sy.No.19 of Chityala Village, Adavidevulapally Mandal, in accordance with Act of 2013 and pass award by paying compensation to the petitioner within a period of eight (8) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
The miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
There shall be no order as to costs.

B. VIJAYSEN REDDY, J June 6 , 2023 DSK Kurakula Venkateshwarlu vs The State Of Telangana on 6 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76033025/
